title: Desktop first-run email round: one press verifies the typed address and approves the round, only with the round's own code from Tracy's origin
steps: S1: boot this checkout's tracy-web (memory store, console mail) on a free port.
S2: open a desktop round with email Y (POST /auth/link/browser); GET /signin?n= with no session; read the page, its token and the host-only tracy_signin_browser cookie.
S3: POST /signin/code without Origin, from another origin, and with a second round's token.

S4: POST /signin/code properly; also send an ordinary web code (POST /login) and a second round's code; POST /signin/verify on round 1 with the web code, with round 2's code, and with the right code but no Origin.
S5: POST /signin/verify with the right code from Tracy; read the session, the round status, redeem the round as the app, press again.
S6: on round 2 send a new code; verify with the old one, then the new one.
expect: The GET names Y and the match code, offers 'Email me a code', mails nothing, and is served with Referrer-Policy same-origin; so is the code step POST /signin/code answers (under no-referrer Chrome posts its form with Origin: null and every press is refused).
Missing Origin, foreign Origin and another round's token are 403 and mail nothing.
The web sign-in code and round 2's code are refused (401); the right code without Origin is 403; the round stays pending.
The right code from Tracy answers 200 with no Approve page, sets tracy_sess for Y, the round is approved, the app's redeem is 204 with a session for Y, a second press is refused.
A new code kills the previous one (401); the new one works (200).
fence: council (a): Origin exact even without a session, round-bound form token, round-bound challenge, one transaction for consume+approve
